CustomField.description: Text formula that returns the branded donor tier name (e.g., Friend, Partner, Champion) based on annual giving against the Annual_Min_Amount__c thresholds in FQS_Donor_Tier custom metadata. Each tier's Credit_Type__c setting controls whether soft credits (CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount) are added to GiftsThisYearAmount for that tier's comparison. Note: GiftsThisYearAmount is a calendar-year rollup from NPC; if your org uses a non-calendar fiscal year, validate whether this aligns with your reporting expectations. Returns blank when the donor is below the Entry annual threshold. Thresholds, branded names, and Credit_Type are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Tier or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold, branded name, or Credit_Type values recalculates this field retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required.
CustomField.formula: IF((GiftsThisYearAmount + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Annual_Min_Amount__c, $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Branded_Name__c, IF((GiftsThisYearAmount + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Annual_Min_Amount__c, $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Branded_Name__c, IF((GiftsThisYearAmount + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Annual_Min_Amount__c, $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Branded_Name__c, "")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. Shows the branded donor tier name for this donor based on their current-year giving (e.g., Friend, Partner, Champion). Blank means the donor is below the Entry annual threshold. Your administrator controls both the threshold amounts and donor tier names.
CustomField.label: Annual Donor Tier Name
